Fact.Name: State: Alaska (no state income tax return)
Fact.Description: #93 state framework: Alaska resident (filers /livedInAk). AS 43.20.012(a)(1)–(2): "The tax imposed by this chapter does not apply to (1) an individual; (2) a fiduciary" (https://www.akleg.gov/basis/statutes.asp?media=print&secStart=43.20.012&secEnd=43.20.012). There's no state return: Alaska is not in /stateReturnComputed or the Switches. Its W-2 box 17 stop (/flowKnockoutAlaskaStateWithholding, formW2s) is wired directly into /flowIsKnockedOut.

Fact.Name: State: Washington (no state income tax return)
Fact.Description: #93 state framework: Washington resident (filers /livedInWa). RCW 82.87.040 imposes the tax on WA long-term capital gains. RCW 82.87.060(1): "A standard deduction of $250,000 per individual, or in the case of spouses or domestic partners, their combined standard deduction is limited to $250,000…", indexed under RCW 82.87.150 (WA DOR: "The standard deduction for 2025 is $278,000"; 2026 figure not yet published). There is no state income tax return: Washington is not in /stateReturnComputed or the Switches. The WA return is not produced. Net long-term gain over the $250,000 statutory floor stops at /flowKnockoutWashingtonCapitalGainsTax (never computed). Its W-2 box 17 stop (/flowKnockoutWashingtonStateWithholding, formW2s) is wired directly into /flowIsKnockedOut.

Fact.Name: State: New Hampshire (no state income tax return)
Fact.Description: #93 state framework: New Hampshire resident (filers /livedInNh). RSA ch. 77 repealed by 2021, 91:99, II, eff. Jan. 1, 2025 (https://gc.nh.gov/rsa/html/V/77/77-mrg.htm). NH DRA: "The I&D Tax was repealed for taxable periods beginning after December 31, 2024" (https://www.revenue.nh.gov/taxes-glance/interest-dividends-tax), and "The State of New Hampshire does not have an income tax on an individual's reported W-2 wages." There is no TY2026 I&D residue, so an I&D stop would block valid returns. There is no state return: New Hampshire is not in /stateReturnComputed or the Switches. Its W-2 box 17 stop (/flowKnockoutNewHampshireStateWithholding, formW2s) is wired directly into /flowIsKnockedOut. There is no Interest and Dividends stop.

Fact.Name: Flow Knockout: Washington capital gains excise tax
Fact.Description: RCW 82.87.040 imposes the tax on WA long-term capital gains. RCW 82.87.060(1): "A standard deduction of $250,000 per individual, or in the case of spouses or domestic partners, their combined standard deduction is limited to $250,000…", indexed under RCW 82.87.150 (WA DOR: "The standard deduction for 2025 is $278,000"; 2026 figure not yet published). Stop when /stateReturnIsWa and federal net long-term gain exceeds $250,000 (statutory floor; deliberately conservative since the indexed amount is higher). Use /scheduleDLine15 when Schedule D is present (/requiresScheduleD), otherwise dividends /totalCapitalGainDistributions. Married filing jointly uses the combined amount against the same single $250,000. The WA return is not produced. Block submission and the printed package. Refs #93.
